pages/dacor-appliance-repair-orange-coun.name: Kathy Calderon
pages/dacor-appliance-repair-orange-coun.body: I had a great experience with AG and this appliance repair service. The technician arrived right on time and was very professional throughout the whole process.
pages/dacor-appliance-repair-orange-coun.poolBody: I had a great experience with AG and this appliance repair service. The technician arrived right on time, clearly explained what might be going on with my washing machine, and gave me a fair estimate upfront. What really impressed me was his dedication—he made a special trip to pick up the needed part and came back on a Saturday morning to complete the repair. Everything is working perfectly now. Professional, courteous, and reliable—couldn't ask for better service!
